fields.Name: T309 - Communication Bulk Runs Timeline
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke runs surface: three count_only summary aggregations plus a hand-rolled status-dot timeline (getRunDotClass/getStatusClass) with its own Refresh — not a grid or generic detail view.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Bulk Runs (Runs) section. Success = the runs view renders a summary row (Active Runs, Completed 24h, Success Rate %) and a run timeline listing runs with status badges/dots (Complete/Failed/In-Progress/Pending) — OR a 'No communication runs found' empty state. Then click the 'Refresh' button and confirm the view reloads and stays functional. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The summary stats (Active / Completed 24h / Success Rate %) render
The run timeline lists runs with status indicators OR shows a valid 'No communication runs found' empty state
Clicking Refresh reloads the view without error; no error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
